title: Add a /version route
description:
## What this does

Adds a /version page that answers with the commit the site was built from, so anyone can check which version is live.

- New file `src/version.js` with `versionInfo()`.
- `src/server.js` answers `/version` with JSON.
- Two new tests in `test/version.test.js`. All tests pass.

I also added a few extra details to the answer to make debugging easier.

Written by an AI coding assistant.
